narrative.intro: Sprezzatura Management Consulting has $240M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Sprezzatura Management Consulting won 7 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $34.3M. Sprezzatura Management Consulting obligations are up 994.4% year over year. Sprezzatura Management Consulting received $234M in Custom Computer Programming Services, $5.6M in Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services, and $300K in Computer Systems Design Services. Sprezzatura Management Consulting obligations by fiscal year rose to $240M in FY26 from $21.9M in FY25, after smaller totals in earlier years: $15.8M in FY21, $15.6M in FY22, $19.4M in FY23, and $13.5M in FY24. The Department of Veterans Affairs is the largest buying agency at $241M. Current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date obligations.

sections.heading: How concentrated is Sprezzatura Management Consulting’s FY2026 business?
sections.body: Custom Computer Programming Services accounts for $234M of Sprezzatura Management Consulting’s $240M in FY2026 obligations. Sprezzatura Management Consulting shows only two other NAICS markets this fiscal year at $5.6M and $300K, which indicates a narrow set of services and high market concentration.

sections.heading: Who are the main federal buyers of Sprezzatura Management Consulting?
